note: Initialized from land-search.md (2026-06-07 survey). The recurring land-scan agent appends new plots here; the site picks them up on next build. Required fields per plot: id, first_seen, address, submarket, price_usd, acreage, listing_url, notes, risks, lat, lng, source. Optional editorial fields used by the site: rank, scenario, dom, hoa, utilities, geo_precision.

plots.address: 414 Blue Creek Dr, Dripping Springs, TX 78620
plots.notes: The cleanest match to the whole brief: gently sloping with multiple build sites, heavy oaks, Hill Country views, light deed restrictions (~$120/yr HOA). 7+ acres gives freedom to site the long axis E–W. Lands squarely in Scenario A (~$1.4M left for build).
plots.risks: A wet-weather creek runs the back — confirm a build pad fully out of FEMA floodplain. Dripping Springs sits over the Barton Springs Edwards recharge zone, which can impose impervious-cover limits; verify before offer.

plots.address: 799 Bell Springs Rd, Dripping Springs, TX 78620
plots.notes: Rolling hills with mature trees and open space, no deed restrictions — maximum design freedom for an unconventional MCM. Large flat building area identified in listing; 8.75 acres gives room to orient the long axis E-W. Scenario A (~$1.4M build budget remaining at the $575k land price).
plots.risks: Unusual 'lightning-bolt' lot shape may constrain build-pad placement — verify on plat before offer. Standard Dripping Springs flag: confirm Edwards Aquifer recharge-zone status (TCEQ) before offer; impervious-cover limits apply in recharge zones. Well + septic required. Price varies across listing sources ($575k–$625k); confirm with listing agent.
